title: Adding Baby Sister to Our Ration Card
title_te: మా రేషన్ కార్డులో చెల్లి పేరు చేర్చడం
problem: Amma stands in long lines at the Meeseva center to add my new baby sister's name to our ration card, but gets sent back because one document is missing.
idea: A one-trip guide. It shows the simple steps to add a new member to the ration card and a checklist so Amma carries every paper the first time.

widgets.heading: 🪪 Steps to Add a New Member
widgets.intro: General steps. The process can change – confirm at your Mee Seva centre or the Civil Supplies website.

items.title: Get birth certificate
items.text: Get the baby's birth certificate from the hospital or Gram Panchayat.
items.te: ఆసుపత్రి లేదా గ్రామ పంచాయతీ నుండి పుట్టిన తేదీ ధృవపత్రం తీసుకోండి.

items.title: Get baby's Aadhaar
items.text: Enrol the baby for Aadhaar at an Aadhaar centre.
items.te: ఆధార్ కేంద్రంలో పాపకు ఆధార్ నమోదు చేయించండి.

items.title: Go to Mee Seva
items.text: Ask for 'member addition in ration card' and give the papers.
items.te: మీసేవలో 'రేషన్ కార్డులో సభ్యుల చేర్పు' కోసం అడగండి.

items.title: Keep the receipt
items.text: Keep the application number receipt safely.

items.title: Check status
items.text: Check the status later at Mee Seva or online using the application number.

widgets.heading: ✅ Amma's Paper Bag Check
widgets.intro: Commonly needed papers. Ask Mee Seva for the exact list before you go.

items.text: Mobile phone linked to Aadhaar (for OTP)

bands.text: Everything is ready. One trip is enough!

how: Ask Gemini for the general steps to add a child to a Telangana ration card.
Visit or call the Mee Seva centre and write down the exact papers they ask for.
Correct the Gemini steps using what the Mee Seva staff said.
Open Canva and make a one-page guide with 4–5 big numbered steps in Telugu.
Add a tick-box list of papers at the bottom.
Print it and keep it with the family file. Share it with neighbours too.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. In simple Telugu, give the general steps to add a newborn baby's name to a family ration card in Telangana. Say clearly that the family should confirm the exact documents at the Mee Seva centre. Keep it to 5 short steps.
